editorial.blurb: Gao's BBQ & Crab is a hidden gem in Chicago serving incredibly flavorful grilled meats and fresh seafood with genuine hospitality and a lively, welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on weekdays to avoid long weekend waits, and don't miss ordering multiple skewer varieties (beef, lamb, chicken skin) to experience the range—the staff happily customize and will remake dishes to your preference.
